title: Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Oval Solid Brass Wall Mount | Satin Nickel | Baskets Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Stop bottles and soap from crowding the shower ledge—this shower basket creates organized, easy-to-reach storage with a distinctive, transitional look in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for humid bathrooms: solid brass construction is designed to never rust
- Clean, finished installation: concealed screw mounting system hides hardware
- Coordinate your bath: part of the Baskets collection for a cohesive set of versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.125 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 8 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 6 lbs
- Mounting: wall mounted; concealed screw mounting system
- Material: solid brass
- Style context: transitional bathroom hardware
multiple designer finish options available
- Assembled in the U.S.A.
